C2_difference_from_C1: frozen V2 surface term disabled (V2 C0 loss)
anchor_control: anchor RGB + anchor depth, same full-role context-camera-derived bounds; a single view never reaches the >=2-view lifting support, so an anchor state of C1/C2 carries the single-view depth bypass and learned priors only

depth_bypass.inputs: context RGB, measured context depth, context cameras; no query
depth_bypass.placement: after the >=2-view support gate: one measured view suffices
depth_bypass.sampling: nearest pixel of the full-resolution measured ray-distance map

only_difference_C0_C1: C1 adds the measured-depth bypass: 3 non-learned statistics per voxel (surface likelihood exp(-(d-D)^2/2s^2), free-space likelihood sigmoid((D-d)/s), valid-view fraction; d voxel-centre distance, D measured ray distance at the nearest pixel, s=exp(log_sigma)*mean voxel edge) through a zero-initialized bias-free 3->8 projection added after the >=2-view support gate, plus log_sigma (25 parameters). All shared parameters, initialization, the 4096 dense candidates, lifting, fusion, refinement, heads, renderer and bounds are unchanged; at initialization C1 and C0 produce identical states.
state: query-independent; all DEV states sealed before query load; >=2 queries/state
